records.issue_text: **`app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1`** — `{{#unless automatic}}` inside the `group-member` itemView template is rendered per-item; depending on how Ember resolves context for `itemView`-based `{{each}}` in this codebase's Ember version, `automatic` could resolve against the member (`User`) object rather than the parent `Group`, which has no such property. If that's the case the remove (×) link would render even for automatic-group members (backend would still reject the request with a silent failure per the issue above). Worth a quick manual QA check against an automatic group (e.g. "admins") to confirm the remove link is actually hidden.

records.issue_text: **`app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:19-33`** — `limit`/`offset` are taken directly from `params` and used unvalidated in the query. Any (non-admin, only `guardian.ensure_can_see!`) caller can pass an arbitrarily large `limit` to defeat the new default page size, or a malformed/negative value that could surface as an unhandled `ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid`. Low severity since it's read-only membership data, but worth clamping (e.g. `limit = [limit, 200].min`).
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members` the diff introduces pagination params: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, which are then used directly in `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`.
